title: Bills sign LB Otis Reese, put LB Demetirus Flannigan-Fowles on IR

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Bills sign LB Otis Reese, put LB Demetirus Flannigan-Fowles on IR
sources.description: Linebacker Otis Reese spent some time on the Bills' practice squad last year and he's back in Buffalo trying to earn a spot on the roster this summer.
